text:
jin: Heads up — urgent gateway shim hotpatch for EU pool. Tokenizer fallback causing intermittent 502s on batch requests. Need expedited approval to patch now, not wait for scheduled window.

 deploy-bot: Deploy request created: PR #4372. Required approvals: eng-release, oncall, qa. To approve: react :thumbsup: or run `/deploy approve`.

 alex: What's the rollback plan? Can we pin to v2.3.1 and revert quickly if needed?

 jin: Rollback plan = pinned tag v2.3.1 + immediate traffic cut to standby pool. Canary would normally run but we're requesting skip; oncall will hold traffic and monitor.

 mira: Ran smoke + perf quick run in staging (5k rps x 2m). No regressions. Logs: https://logs.redwood/streams/pr_4372

 oncall: Prefer canary, but OK to expedite if alex + sam sign off. I can hold traffic 00:00–00:15 UTC and watch metrics.

 sam: +1 if traffic hold + rollback pin set. Ops runbook updated with steps.

 alex: +1. Please add emergency flag in metadata and record the reason for skipping canary.

 deploy-bot: Approvals: 3/3. Initiating deploy to eu-west1. Command: `deploy --env=prod --region=eu-west1 --tag=hotfix-gw-20260320 --skip-canary=true`

 deploy-bot: Canary skipped by unanimous expedite. Expected: small latency blips possible. Notifying PD schedule.

 jin: Rolling out now. Will post step updates.

 deploy-bot: [1/4] pushing images — done.

 deploy-bot: [2/4] rolling pods — 12/12 done.

 deploy-bot: [3/4] health checks — passing.

 deploy-bot: [4/4] traffic switch — completed.

 jin: Done. Monitoring the next 5 minutes.

 oncall: Seeing a brief 5xx spike to 0.8% at 00:03, trending down. holding traffic hold in place.

 mira: Traces look clean, no tail latency regression on top requests.

 alex: Noting for release notes: "hotfix: gateway shim — fix batch tokenizer fallback causing 502s" — include in changelog and docs.

 jin: Thanks all. Closing out. :tada:
